name: Catch Flame
entries: You quickly create a momentary spark in your hand to burn a nearby enemy. Make a melee spell attack roll, dealing 1d4 fire damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell’s damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Crystal Barrage
entries: You conjure a small barrage of small glintstone shards in a 15ft long, 5 ft wide line, striking the first enemy it comes in contact with. Affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 force damage on a fail. Creatures within 5 feet of you when you cast this spell have disadvantage on the saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell’s damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (3d6), 11th level (4d6) and 17th level (5d6).

name: Glintstone Pebble
entries: You conjure a small blue shard and fire it at an enemy within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier force damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell’s damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6) and 17th level (4d6).

name: Gravitas
entries: You slam the ground, creating a burst of gravitational energy that radiates out from you. Each creature in a 10-foot radius must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 1d10 Force damage and be pulled 5 feet towards you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell’s damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10) and 17th level (4d10).

name: Honed Bolt
entries: You conjure a long bolt of lightning in your hand, hurling it at an enemy within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 1d10 lightning damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell’s damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10) and 17th level (4d10).

name: Swift Glintstone Shard
entries: You quickly conjure a small blue shard and fire it at an enemy within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 1d4 force damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell’s damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4) and 17th level (4d4).

name: Beastial Constitution
entries: You touch a creature, removing any blood loss buildup on it and any penalties to its movement.

name: Beastial Sling
entries: You fling sharp rocks at high velocity in front of you, embedding them in creatures in a 15ft cone. All creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 piercing damage on a fail or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Black Flame
entries: Creating a large ball of black flames in your hand, you throw it at a point within range. All creatures within 10 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 black fire damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 per spell slot above 1st level.

name: Carian Slicer
entries: You summon a blade at the end of your staff that slices through objects and foes alike. Make a melee spell attack roll, dealing 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage on a hit. If you benefit from extra attack or have another action on your turn, you may swing the magic blade again on your turn without expending a spell slot.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Crystal Burst
entries: You conjure a large barrage of small glintstone shards in a 20ft cone, hitting the first creatures that come in contact with and not affecting creatures behind them. Affected creatures inside the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures within 5 feet of you when you cast this spell make the save with disadvantage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Cure Poison
entries: You touch a creature with a cleansing hand, removing the poisoned condition from them. Target creature has advantage on Constitution saving throws against being poisoned for the next hour.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target an additional creature within 10 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Electrify Armament
entries: You touch a target weapon, enchanting it with lightning. All attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 1d6 lightning damage on a hit. If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 per spell slot above 1st level.

name: Flame Cleanse Me
entries: You touch a willing creature with cleansing flame, dealing 1d4 fire damage and removing any traces of poison or scarlet rot.

name: Frozen Armament
entries: You touch a target weapon, enchanting it with ice. All attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 1d6 cold damage on a hit. If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Glintblade Phalanx
entries: You summon a small group of 5 glinstone blades that float about your head, which last for 1 minute. Whenever a creature of your choice walks within 15 feet of you, all 5 blades fire at it. Target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 force damage on a success, or half as much on a failure.
Creatures have disadvantage on this saving throw if it triggers immediately after you cast this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you summon two additional blades (dealing an additional 2d4) for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Gravity Well
entries: You fire a small, dark purple projectile at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack dealing 2d8 force damage on a hit. Regardless of the outcome, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw, pulling them 10 feet closer on a failure as the projectile pulls them towards it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 and the pull distance by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Great Glintstone Shard
entries: You conjure a large glintstone shard and fire it at an enemy within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 2d8 + your spell attack modifier force damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Immutable Shield
entries: You touch a shield wielded by a creature, enchanting it with divine protection. The user of that shield increases their AC by 1 and reduces physical, radiant, necrotic, and force damage taken by 1d6 while using it. If you reduce the damage to 0, you take no damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you reduce the damage taken from magic by an additional 1d6 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Lightning Spear
entries: You conjure a bolt of lightning and hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 3d8 lightning damage on a hit. When you hit a creature wearing metal armor with this spell, you deal extra lightning damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 per spell slot above 1st level.

name: Order's Blade
entries: You touch a target weapon, enchanting it with holy magic. All attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 1d6 radiant damage on a hit. If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 per spell slot above 1st level.

name: Poison Armament
entries: You touch a target weapon, enchanting it with poison. All attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 1d6 poison damage on a hit. If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 per spell slot above 1st level.

name: Scan
entries: You target a creature within range to try to learn about how high their vitality is. The target must make a Charisma Save, on a fail you learn their hit point maximum, how many hit points they have remaining, and if they have any abilities that may give them more hit points (such as Mythic phases), and how much that ability restores. During this, you know precisely how many hit points the creature has left and can freely recieve that information.
This lasts for one minute or until the creature dies.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within range per spell slot above 1st.

name: Scholar's Armament
entries: You touch a target weapon, enchanting it with magical energy. All attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 1d6 force damage on a hit. If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 per spell slot above 1st level.

name: Scholar's Shield
entries: You touch a shield wielded by a creature. The user of that shield increases their AC by one and reduces all magic damage taken by 1d6 while using it. If you reduce the damage to 0, you take no damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you reduce the damage taken from magic by an additional 1d6 for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Soothing Symphony
entries: You target a creature within range that can hear you. The target must make a Charisma saving throw or suffer disadvantage on either physical or mental saving throws. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending it on a success. A creature automatically succeeds if it can no longer hear you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within range.

name: Sorrowful Song
entries: You target a creature within range that can hear you. The target must make a Charisma saving throw or suffer disadvantage on either physical or spell attack rolls. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending it on a success. A creature automatically succeeds if it can no longer hear you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within range.

name: Ambush Shard
entries: You summon a dark blade behind a creature within range. The target must make a Perception check contested with your Spell Save DC. On a failure, you gain advantage on the following attack. Make a ranged spell attack, dealing 4d6 force damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and the DC increases by 2 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Assassin's Approach
entries: You touch a creature, silencing their footsteps as they move. The target has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks on moving silently and resistance to fall damage for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Beastial Claw
entries: You drag your hand through the ground, ripping the earth in a great slashing motion in a 15ft cone. All creatures in the cone must make a Strength saving throw, taking 3d10 slashing damage on a fail and are knocked prone, or half as much on a success, evading prone.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Black Flame Blade

components.m: (a melee weapon wielded by a creature)

entries: You touch a target weapon, enchanting it with black flames. All attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 1d10 black flame damage on a hit.
If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blood Blade
entries: You swing your weapon, causing a line of blood to shoot out from the weapon in a 5ft wide, 15ft long line. When you first cast this spell, you take 2d4 necrotic damage. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures take Blood Loss equal to half the damage taken. If you benefit from Extra Attack or similar features, you can cast this spell again without expending a spell slot for as many attacks as you can make.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 2nd, but you take 1d4 more necrotic damage.

name: Bloodboon
entries: You twirl your hand in the air, drawing nearby blood on the ground before tossing it aside, creating a line of boiling flames. You create a 5ft wide, 20ft long line at a point within range. All creatures that start their turn or enter the space for the first time must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 fire damage on fail, or half as much on success. Creatures gain bloodloss buildup equal to half the damage taken.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blood Flame Blade

components.m: (A melee weapon wielded by a creature)

entries: You touch a target weapon, enchanting it with bloody flames. All attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 1d8 fire damage on a hit. Creatures hit gain bloodloss buildup equal to the fire damage taken.
If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blood Flame Talons
entries: You slash through the air, igniting the air before you in bloody flames. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a fail or half as much on a success. A creature gains Bloodloss buildup equal to half the damage taken.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blood Mending
entries: You pull the blood from your body and wrap it around a wounded creature you can see within range, commanding it to heal itself. You take 1d6 Necrotic damage when casting this spell, and the target heals hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. The damage cannot be reduced in any way. This spell cannot be cast by creature without blood, nor can it affect a creature without blood.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 3rd level spell slot or higher, you heal an additional 1d8 hit points, but take an additional 1d6 damage per spell slot above 2nd.

name: Carian Greatsword
entries: You summon a massive blade at the end of your staff that slices through objects and foes alike. This blade has a reach of 10 feet. Make a melee spell attack roll against two targets within 15 feet of eachother, dealing 3d6 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage on a hit. If you benefit from extra attack or have another action on your turn, you may swing the magic blade again on your turn without expending a spell slot.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Cragblade

components.m: (A melee weapon weilded by a creature)

entries: You slam a weapon into the ground, causing jagged stone to stick the weapon. The weapon now deals Bludgeoning damage instead of its normal type, and is considered magical for the purposes of overcoming resistsances. Additionally, it deals an extra 2d6 Bludgeoning damage on hit.
If you lose concentration on this spell before 1 minute has passed, the effects linger until the next successful hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Discus of Light
entries: You conjure a small discus of light and throw it in a 5ft wide, 30ft long line. The discus the returns to your hand, passing the same way it came. Whenever the discus passes through a creature it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d6 radiant damage on fail or half as much on success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Divine Fortification
entries: You touch a creature, granting it divine protection. The target creature gains resistance to either necrotic or radiant damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Earthen Spike
entries: You thrust your hand toward the ground, summoning a line of spikes up to a target within range. Any creature in this line takes 1d4 piercing damage. When the line reaches its target, you thrust your hand upward, creating a massive rocky spike that explodes from the ground. The target and adjacent creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw, the target taking 3d8 piercing damage and getting knocked prone on a fail, or half as much on a success. Adjacent creatures take 3d4 piercing damage on a fail. Creatures Huge or larger cannot be knocked prone.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for the d8s and 1d4 for the d4s for each slot level above 2nd. Additionally, when cast at 4th level, the spike may knock Huge or smaller creatures prone, and Gargantuan creatures at 6th.

name: Fire's Deadly Sin
entries: Hands alight with flames, you slam them into the ground, causing flames to burst around you in a 10ft radius centered on you. All creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a fail or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and the radius by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Flame Fortification
entries: You touch a willing creature, blessing it with fire resistance for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Freezing Mist
entries: You summon a cloud of cold energy in a 10-foot radius sphere within range. Creatures that enter this cloud for the first time or start their turn in it take 1d6 cold damage, and their speed is reduced by 10 feet.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the cloud up to 15 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6, and the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Frenzied Burst
entries: You fill your eyes with the Frenzied Flames, unleashing a maddening bolt towards a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 6d6 fire damage on a hit. A creature takes madness buildup equal to 1/3 the damage taken. Additionally, the caster gains 1d10 madness buildup.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.When you cast this spell using a spell slot of (level+1) level or higher, the damage increases by (damage die) per spell slot above (level) level.

name: Howl of Shibriri
entries: You grasp your eyes, Frenzied Flames filling them as you let out a maddening howl. All creatures within 20 feet must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 3d10 psychic damage, or half as much on a fail. A creature gains madness buildup equal to half the damage taken. Additionally, the caster gains madness buildup equal to half the damage rolled.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Lightning Fortification
entries: You touch a willing creature, blessing it with lightning resistance for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Lucidity
entries: You touch a creature, clearing its mind, removing any minor madness effects, and removing the need for sleep for the day.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature within 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Magic Fortification
entries: You touch a creature, blessing it with magic resistance. The target has resistance to force damage for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature within 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Magma Shot
entries: You fire a glob of magma from the top of your staff to a point within range. All creatures within 10 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The area is then coated with magma for 1d4 turns, dealing 1d6 fire damage to any creature that starts its turn there or enters it for the first time. This magma is also considered difficult terrain.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 and 1d6, respectively, for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Night Maiden's Mist
entries: You summon a cloud of life-sapping energy in a 10-foot radius sphere within range. Creatures that enter this cloud for the first time, start or end their turn in it, take 1d6 force damage.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the cloud up to 15 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6, and the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Poison Mist
entries: You summon a cloud of poison mist in a 10-foot radius sphere within range. Creatures that enter this cloud for the first time, start or end their turn in it, take 1d6 poison damage.
As a bonus action on your turn you can move the cloud up to 15 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6, and the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Prayerful Strike
entries: Make a melee attack with a weapon you are holding. You can choose to use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of this attack. On a hit, the target takes an extra 2d8 radiant damage. You and all creatures of your choicewithin 15ft of you regain hit points equal to half the radiant damage dealt (rounded up).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd level.

name: Rock Blaster
entries: You charge up energy at the bottom of your staff before thrusting it into the ground. All creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Dexterity Saving throw, taking 3d8 force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Rock Sling
entries: You pull three rocks from the ground and fling them at a single enemy within range. Make three ranged attack rolls, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage per hit. If the terrain is not rocky enough to cast this spell, it fails and the spell slot is not wasted.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you summon an additional rock beyond the first 3 for each level above 2nd.

name: Shard Spiral
entries: You summon a dual spiral of Glinstone magic that flies at an enemy within range. Make two ranged spell attack rolls against the target, dealing 2d8 force damage per hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 per hit for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Stone of Gurannq
entries: You grab a large chunk of earth and hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 4d8 bludgeoning damage on a hit. When hit, a creature must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Swarm of Flies
entries: You summon a cloud of bloody flies in a 10-foot radius sphere within range. Creatures that enter this cloud for the first time or end their turn in it take 1d6 piercing damage. Creatures gain blood loss buildup equal to half the damage they take.
As a bonus action on your turn you can move the cloud up to 15 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6, and the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Thop's Barrier
entries: When targeted with a ranged spell attack, you may use your reaction to try to deflect it. This spell automatically deflects 2nd level and lower ranged spell attacks. For higher-level spells, make a check using your spellcasting ability, the DC being 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell is deflected elsewhere, and on a failure, the spell slot used to cast this spell slot is not wasted.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, it automatically deflects spells of equal level and lower.

name: Unseen Blade
entries: You touch a weapon, imbuing it with magical cloaking, turning it invisible for the duration. This effect ends if the weapon is used to deal damage. Attacks with this weapon while it is invisible are made with advantage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional weapon within 5 feet of you per spell slot above 2nd.

name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
entries: You conjure a bolt of ancient dragon lightning and hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 3d12 AD lightning damage on a hit. When you hit a creature wearing metal armor with this spell, you deal extra lightning damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Waves of Darkness
entries: You slam the ground, causing a wave of gravitational energy to emanate from you. Each creature of your choice in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d6 Force damage and is push back 5 feet. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed back. At the start of your next 2 turns, the wave emanates again from where you originally cast the spell, causing the same effect on creatures in the area. The spell ends after the wave emanates for the third time. You are not effected by this spell whenever any waves appear.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Ancient Dragon's Lightning Strike
entries: Drawing on ancient draconic lightning, you cause red lightning to strike around you. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 AD Lightning damage on a fail or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Atium Shadows

components.m: (A small ball of rare metal that you swallow when you cast this spell)

entries: Target a creature that you can see within 120 feet that must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you gain insight into how it will take its turn, including where it plans to move, who it will attack, what spell it will cast, etc, through blue shadows that reveal its movement. You have advantage on attack rolls against the target, and it has disadvantage on saving throws against your spells. It has disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have advantage on saving throws against their effects.

The target may change their plans before their turn arrives based on circumstances, such as moving around difficult terrain that appeared via a spell. When this happens, you are notified of this change as long as you are still concentrating on this spell.
A creature can repeat the save at the end of its turn (ignoring the disadvantage from this spell), ending the effect on a success. On a failure, you gain insight of their next turn.

name: Black Flame Ritual
entries: Hand alight with black flames, you draw up black flames around you in a 10ft radius centered on you. All creatures in the area (not including you) must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d6 black fire damage on a fail or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and the radius by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Cacophony of Concentration
entries: You touch a willing creature within range. The target gains supernatural concentration on either physical or mental tasks.
Physical concentration gives advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution rolls.
Mental concentration gives advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma rolls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target gains a +1 bonus to their rolls, +2 at 6th, and +3 at 8th.

name: Eternal Darkness
entries: You create a small sphere of pure darkness at a point within range. All 3rd-level or lower spells cast within 30 feet of the sphere that fire projectiles are drawn to the sphere, either missing or detonating in that area. Line spells that move through the area are curved 45 degrees towards the sphere.
Spells that fire projectiles usually make ranged spell attack rolls or have it in their description, such as fireball.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, spells of equal level or lower are pulled into the sphere.

name: Flame Whip
entries: Target a creature within range, slinging a long whip of fire at them. The target must make a Strength saving throw, taking 8d8 Fire damage on a fail or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail are pulled up to 15ft closer to you (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target an additional creature within 10ft of the original target per spell slot above 3rd.

name: Frozen Lightning Spear
entries: Drawing on draconic energies, you create a massive frozen lightning spear and slam it into the ground, causing lightning to strike in a 15ft wide, 60ft long line. All creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 cold damage and 4d6 lightning damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, both damages increase by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Gavel of Hamia
entries: You conjure a massive hammer and slam it into the ground, creating a 10ft radius shockwave around you. All creatures in the area (except you) must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
If you benefit from extra attack, you may cast this spell again on your turn for each attack without expending a spell slot.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Gelmir's Fury
entries: Channeling deep magma beneath the earth, you slam your staff into the ground, sending magma hurtling in the air around you. All creatures in a 15ft radius sphere centered on you (excluding you) must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 fire damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. The area in the sphere becomes difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
As an action on subsequent turns while concentrating, you can create this effect again.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Greatblade Phalanx
entries: You conjure a small group of 3 large glinstone blades that float about your head, which last for 1 minute. Whenever a creature of your choice walks within 20 feet of you, all 3 blades fire at it. Target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
Creatures have disadvantage on this saving throw if it triggers immediately after you cast this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you conjure an additional blade (dealing an extra 2d6) for each spell slot above 3rd.

name: Gurranq's Beast Claw
entries: You slam a clawed hand into the ground and rip up the ground around you. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw, taking 8d6 slashing damage on a fail and are knocked prone, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Law of Causality
entries: You touch a willing creature, granting it a damage-storing blessing. Any time a creature takes damage, you gain one casualty stack. When this spell ends, the blessed creature expels the stored damage. All creatures within 10 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 radiant damage per casualty stack, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target starts with an additional 2 casualty stacks per spell slot above 3rd.

name: Lord's Aid
entries: You bless all creatures of your choice within 20 feet (including yourself), removing any blood loss, scarlet rot buildup, and curing poison and scarlet rot. Creatures asleep due to magical means are also awakened.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Loretta's Greatbow
entries: You conjure a large glintstone bow and fire one arrow at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 5d8 force damage on a hit, or half as much on a miss.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 3rd as you knock another arrow.

name: Noble's Presence
entries: You thrust out your belly with gusto, unleashing a shockwave. All creatures within 10 feet must make a Strength saving throw. Creatures that fail take 4d6 bludgeoning and 4d6 black fire damage, are pushed 10 feet away, and are knocked prone. Creatures that succeed take half as much damage and are only pushed 5 feet away.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the black fire damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.When you cast this spell using a spell slot of (level+1) level or higher, the damage increases by (damage die) per spell slot above (level) level.

name: Roiling Magma
entries: You conjure a mote of roiling magma to a point within range, which remains there while you concentrate. When your concentration ends, all creatures within 15 feet of the mote must make a Dexterity saving throw as it explodes, taking 5d8 fire damage on failure or half as much on a success.

The area of the explosion becomes difficult terrain for a number of rounds equal to your spellcasting ability modifier as it becomes coated with magma. All creatures that start their turn or enter the magma for the first time on their turn take 1d8 fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Scouring Black Flame
entries: Hands alight with black flames, you throw them in a 20ft cone about you. All creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d8 black fire damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Shooting Star
entries: You hurl a streaking star from the palm of your hand into a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 8d8 force damage and is revealed until the end of their next turn. A revealed creature cannot benefit from the invisible condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 per slot above 3rd level.

name: Star Shower
entries: You conjure a barrage of 6 glintstone stars at enemies within range. You can choose to fire up to 3 at one creature in range, making a ranged spell attack roll for each, dealing 2d6 force damage per hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you conjure an additional star and increase the amount of stars that can target one person by 1 for each spell slot above 4th.

name: Surge O Flame
entries: Holding out your hand, flames fly out in a 20ft long, 5ft wide line. All creatures in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a fail or half as much on a success. While concentrating on this spell, you can use an action on your turn to recast it without expending a spell slot.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: The Flame of Frenzy
entries: You release a burst of yellow flame tendrils from your eyes in a 20ft cone. Each target in the area must make an Intelligence saving throw or take 4d8 fire damage, with half as much on a success. Creatures who take damage gain a Madness buildup equal to 1/3 of the damage they take. Additionally, the caster gains 1d10 madness buildup.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Zamor Ice Storm
entries: Slamming your staff or hands into the ground, you create a large ice storm around you. All creatures in a 20ft radius sphere centered on you (excluding you) must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d6 cold damage on a failure, reducing their move speed by half, or half as much on a failure with no adverse effects.

You can continue to channel this spell at the start of your turn as an action while you concentrate, forcing all creatures in the area to make the save again. While concentrating on this spell, your move speed is reduced by half.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Adula's Moonblade
entries: You summon a massive blade at the end of your staff that slices through objects and foes alike. Make a melee spell attack roll against two targets, dealing 4d6 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage on a hit.

All creatures in a 15ft wide, 25 ft long line when you swing must make a Dexterity Saving throw, taking 2d6 force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures hit by this spell’s melee attack have disadvantage on the saving throw.
If you benefit from extra attack or have another action on your turn, you may swing the magic blade again on your turn without expending a spell slot.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for both effects for each slot level above 4th.

name: Ancient Dragon's Lightning Spear
entries: Drawing on ancient draconic lightning, you create a massive lightning spear and slam it into the ground. All creatures adjacent to you and in four 5-foot-wide, 15-foot-long lines that are 90 degrees from each other must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 AD lightning damage on a fail or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Black Blade
entries: You conjure the Black Blade of death, swinging it at a creature within 10 feet. Make a melee spell attack roll, dealing 4d6 slashing damage and 4d6 black fire damage on a hit.

This blade also creates a wave of black flames in the direction you swing, hitting the first target beyond the melee target within 30ft. Make a ranged spell attack roll, ignoring disadvantage from being in enemy melee range, dealing 4d6 black fire damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, all black fire damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Cannon of Hamia
entries: You fire a large blast of magical energy at a target location within range. All creatures in a 20ft radius sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 force damage or half as much on a failure.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 5th spell slot or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Collapsing Stars
entries: You create 9 gravity projectiles and launch them at foes within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make 9 spell attack rolls, dealing 1d8 force damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you create an additional projectile for every spell slot level above 4th.

name: Flame Grant Me Strength
entries: You touch a creature, blessing it with great fire powers. The target gains fire resistance and whenever it deals fire damage it may roll twice with each die, taking the higher result for each roll.

name: Gravitational Missile
entries: You create a large gravity well at a point within range, pulling creatures toward its center. When a creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the gravity well, which is difficult terrain, it must make a Strength saving throw, being pulled 10 feet closer on a failure or 5 feet on a success.
When a creature starts its turn or becomes adjacent to the well for the first time, it takes 2d10 force damage.
When you end concentration, all creatures within 10 feet of the well must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d10 force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the final explosion damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Inescapable Frenzy
entries: Eyes filled with frenzied flames, you grab a creature and blast frenzied flames into its face. Target a creature within 5 feet, forcing an Intelligence saving throw, taking 6d10 fire damage on a fail or half as much on a success. A creature gains madness buildup equal to 1/3 of the damage taken. Additionally, the caster gains 1d10 madness buildup.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Laser Ray
entries: A ray of fire ignites from your hands, shooting out in a 120ft long, 15ft wide line. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d8 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

This spell leaves a trail of flaming clouds in its wake for the next minute. A creature that ends its turn in the cloud or enters it for the first time (except on the casting of the spell) takes 2d6 fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Litany of Proper Death
entries: You bless the ground within range, blasting a 20ft radius sphere with holy energy. All creatures of your choice in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d6 radiant damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. Targets that fail are also blinded.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Terra Magica
entries: You bless the ground for magic users 10 feet around you, empowering the spells of all those who cast spells in it. You must be on a solid surface to cast this spell. While in this circle, when a creature casts a 4th-level spell or lower, it has advantage on spell attack rolls, creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against its spells, and counts as one level higher (except for this spell).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, spells of equal level or lower are boosted by this effect.

name: Black Flame Tornado
entries: You spin your weapon above your head, creating a swirling tornado of black flames that extends out from you in a 20ft radius. All creatures within the radius must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 6d6 Black Fire damage. While concentrating on this spell, you can use your action to cast this spell again without expending a spell slot. If you use your action to do anything else, this spell ends. When this spell ends, it creates one final tornado as if you had recast it using your action.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Comet
entries: You conjure a large glinstone comet at a creature within range. Make a spell attack roll, dealing 12d6 force damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Moonstone's Fists
entries: You conjure a pair of gauntleted spectral fists over the target’s hands, who have fine control over them. While the spell lasts, the target can use an action to make two melee attacks with either the caster’s spellcasting ability or their strength, dealing 4d8 force damage on a hit. The caster can make these attacks as part of the casting of the spell.
If the target benefits from any sort of extra attack feature, they may make 1 additional attack per extra attack they have.

Doing enough damage on one attack with these fists may knock a creature prone based on its size. If the required damage is met, the creature must make a Strength Saving Throw against the spellcaster’s Spell Save DC or be knocked prone.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th

name: Radagon's Rings of Light
entries: You create a ring of light above your head and expanding around you. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 radiant damage on a fail or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Staccato/Legato
entries: The rhythm of your music dictates the pace of your magic. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following effects:

Staccato. When you deal damage to a target that is within 30 feet of you with a spell or an attack, two musical echoes also hit that target, each one dealing 1d4 of the same damage type of your spell or attack. When you heal a target that is within 30 feet of you, two musical echoes also heal that target, each one healing 1d4 hit points.

Legato. When you deal damage to a target that is within 30 feet of you with a spell or an attack, that target takes 1d4 of the same type of damage of your spell or attack at the start of each of your turns until you cast another spell on it or until your Legato ends (because the spell ends or because you changed the rhythm to Staccato.) When you heal a target that is within 30 feet of you, that target regains 1d4 hit points at the start of each of your turns until you cast another spell on it or until Legato ends.
The area moves with you and is always centered on you, its effects also apply on you, and for the duration of the spell you can change from one effect to the other as a bonus action.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the effects of the spell increase by 1d4 per level above 5th. (Staccato = 3 musical notes, 3d4+ ; Legato = 2 per turn, 2d4+)

name: Unendurable Frenzy
entries: With frenzied flames in your eyes, you blast out flames in a 15-foot cone in front of you. Creatures in the area must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a success, or half as much on a failure. A creature that takes damage gains madness buildup equal to 1/3 of the damage taken.
While concentrating, you can choose to recast this spell as an action on your turn without expending a spell slot. The caster gains 1d6 madness buildup every time they cast this spell.

Whenever you drop concentration, you release a burst of frenzied flames all around you. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 6d6 fire damage on a fail or half as much on a success. A creature that takes damage gains madness buildup equal to 1/3 of the damage taken, and the caster gains 1d6 madness buildup.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, all damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Blades of Stone
entries: You call forth the earth, bending it to you will around a point within range. All creatures in a 30ft radius sphere must make a Strength saving throw, taking 4d8 piercing damage and 4d8 bludgeoning damage and being knocked prone on a failure or half as much on a success with no adverse effects.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for both damage types for each slot level above 6th.

name: Crescendo

components.m: (a handful of snow and a few drops of vegetable oil)

entries: Bolstered with magic, your music amplifies the power of the companions that can hear you. Choose one ability between strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom or charisma : at the start of each of your turns for the duration of the spell, you and all of your allies that are within 30 feet of you get a +1 to this ability modifier (up to a maximum of +3). That bonus lasts until the spell ends or until the ally ends its turn more than 30 feet away from you.
When an ally (or you) get the maximum bonus, they also gain one of the following benefits, according the the ability you chose :
Crescendo of Strength: Your carry capacity is doubled and you can grapple creatures that are 2 sizes larger than you.
Crescendo of Dexterity: Your speed is increased by 10ft.
Crescendo of Constitution: When you should take damage, you take 3 less damage.
Crescendo of Intelligence: You can add your intelligence modifer to the damage roll of your cantrips.
Crescendo of Wisdom: You gain true sight within a 10 foot range.
Crescendo of Charisma: You can take the help action as a bonus action.

name: Epidemic of Fire
entries: You create a stream of fire that erupts from your hands to a target of your choice within range. The stream then leaps out to another target within 30ft of the first, and then to another within 30ft of the second, chaining up to 4 times. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by one one of the streams.
A target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 12d6 fire damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, one additional stream jumps from the previous target to another target within 30ft for each slot level above 6th.

name: Founding Rain of Stars
entries: You conjure a small number of stars which fly into the air above a point within range, creating a large cloud which rains stars which remains for the duration. All creatures in a 20ft sphere that start their turn under the cloud or enter it for the first time must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Lansseax's Glaive
entries: Channeling ancient dragon magic, you create a massive glaive and sweep it, sending red lightning throughout a 60ft cone. All creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 AD Lightning damage on a fail or half as much on a success. Creatures adjacent to you when you cast this spell have disadvantage on the saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Rykard's Rancor
entries: You conjure a large flaming skull that travels across the battlefield, leaving explosions in its wake. This skull has a movement of 60 feet, can move through other creatures’ spaces, and cannot move diagonally. Every creature that this skull passes through must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. A creature only makes this saving throw once per casting of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and the move speed by 10 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Stars of Ruin
entries: You conjure a large barrage of 12 glintstone stars at enemies within range. You can choose to fire up to 4 at one creature in range, making a ranged spell attack roll for each, dealing 2d8 force damage per hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you conjure an additional star and increase the amount of stars that can target one person by 1 for each spell slot above 6th.

name: Triple Rings of Light
entries: You create three large rings of light and toss them out, striking enemies they pass through. All creatures in a 30ft cone must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6 radiant damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. The rings then return to you, forcing the save against creatures in the cone, still dealing 6d6 radiant damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Avasculate
entries: You fire a ray of black necrotic energy at a target within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d6 + 30 Necrotic damage and becoming stunned on a fail as their body purges their blood and vital fluids through their skin. On a success, the target takes half damage and is not stunned.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by 4d6 for each slot level above 7th level.

name: Ranni's Dark Moon/Rennalla's Full Moon
entries: You levitate yourself into the air and curl into a ball, forming a large moon around you. Ejecting itself out, it fires itself at a target point within range. All creatures within a 20ft radius sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 12d6 force damage on failure, or half as much on a success.
You cannot cast this spell if your move speed is zero.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 7th.

name: Scarlet Aeonia
entries: You rise up into the air, a scarlet aeonia forming around you. You come crashing down at a point within 30 feet, the aeonia blooming into a massive explosion. All creatures within 30 feet of where you land must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d10 Scarlet Rot damage on a fail or half as much on a success. A creature takes scarlet rot buildup equal to 1/3 the damage it takes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d10 for each slot level above 7th.

name: Comet Azur
entries: You charge up powerful magics, unleashing a blast of powerful glintstone energy in a 5ft wide, 120ft long line. All creatures that start their turn in the line, or enter it for the first time, must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 force damage on failure, or half as much on a success.

While concentrating on this spell, you can take an action on your turn to recast this spell in the same area without expending a spell slot, otherwise, it ends. Additionally, you cannot move while casting this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell at 9th level, you gain the ability to rotate this spell up to 90 degrees when you recast this spell on your turn. The damage also increases by 2d8.

name: Fortissax's Lightning Spear
entries: Channeling the pinnacle of ancient dragon magic, you summon two massive spears and slam them into the ground. All creatures within 25 feet of you must make two dexterity saving throws, taking 8d6 AD Lightning damage per failure, or half as much of each on a success.
A creature that fails the first of the two saving throws has disadvantage on the second.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell at 9th level, the damage increases to 10d6 for both saves, and the radius increases to 30 feet.

name: Rellana's Twin Moons
entries: You levitate yourself into the air and curl into a ball, forming a large moon around you. Your moon creates a twin that slams into the ground shortly before yours does. All creatures in a 20ft radius sphere (not including you) must make 2 Dexterity saving throws, taking 8d6 force damage per failure, or half as much of each on a success.
A creature that fails the first of the two saving throws has disadvantage on the second.
You cannot cast this spell if your move speed is zero.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the damage increases by 2d6 for both moons.

name: Ethereal Storm
entries: You summon a storm of ethereal energy in a 60ft radius at point you can see within range. As an action on each of your turns and when you cast this spell, you can cause three bolts of ethereal energy to strike a creature of your choice within the radius. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 damage of a random type on a fail, or half as much on a success.
To determine the damage type, roll a d6 and consult the following:
A creature can only be affected by one bolt per turn.
